A synthetic article for smoke tests

Rapid serial visual presentation shows one word at a time at a fixed point, so the eyes never have to travel across a line of text.

This fixture exists only so the end-to-end test has a stable page with enough text in an article element for page extraction to pick it up instead of falling back to the body.

None of these sentences mean anything in particular; they are filler that is long enough to cross the three hundred character threshold used by the extractor.
